messages:
tara: RCA posted: Quantization regression caused truncated outputs for some 8-bit model variants. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-3572
tara: TL;DR: a serialization mismatch in the quantized weights during a model rollout produced spuriously short generations (~30-60 tokens) for ~6% of requests on affected model family. Impact window ~50m during the rollout.
tara: Immediate mitigation during incident: rolled back to previous quantized artifact, paused auto-rollout, and disabled the problematic optimization pass.
kevin: Thanks. Can you list the concrete action items and owners so we can close the loop?
tara: Yep 4dd high-level actions:
- Q1: Add artifact checksum validation + preflight for quantized model assets (owner: kevin)
- Q2: Add unit & integration tests for the optimization pass (owner: liz)
- Q3: Improve rollout gating to include generation-length smoke tests (owner: owen)
- Q4: Add post-rollout anomaly detector for sudden median generation length drops (owner: marco)
- Q5: Customer communication note + translations for support (owner: tara)
liz: Taking Q2. Will add tests that run small generation cases and validate token length distributions. ETA: PR by Tue.
kevin: I'll take Q1. Plan: bake checksum into model manifest + CI preflight. ETA: 2025-05-12.
owen: Q3 here. I'll extend the rollout pipeline to run a quick end-to-end generation test on canaries and block if median length drops >10%.
marco: Q4 acknowledged. I'll add a Grafana panel and a low-severity alert if generation length deviates by more than 3 sigma.
tara: I've added a short customer-facing summary to the RCA and a list of customers we flagged for outreach.
incident-bot: RCA RC-3572 created by tara. Title: "Quantized rollout regression 1: truncated generations on 8-bit models" 4c4 https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENG/pages/RC-3572
kevin: Please drop PR links here as you open them so we can track closure in the RCA.
tara: Calendar invites: 1-week checkpoint 2025-05-15 09:00 PT, 30-day review 2025-06-12 09:00 PT. I'll attach an agenda to the invite.
liz: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/134 44d tests + harness for optimization pass.
kevin: Preflight manifest PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifacts/pull/47 4c1 awaiting review.
owen: Rollout pipeline change PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/deploy/pull/612 527 will add the smoke test step.
marco: Monitoring PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/429 4ca adds median-length panels & alert.
tara: I'll follow up with support to send the customer note and collect any outstanding reports.
marco: For recordings: I captured a short replay of the failing generation traces and linked in the RCA.
kevin: Thanks team. Let's aim to have the 1-week checkpoint with short demos of the tests and dashboards. Post blockers here or DM me. :white_check_mark:
tara: Thanks all. Closing thread for now; tracking continues in the RCA and PRs. :rocket:
